# HighLevel API v2 import research (as of 2026-10-17)

Base `https://services.leadconnectorhq.com`, `Authorization: Bearer <PIT>`, `Version: 2021-07-28`. Note: the unversioned docs at marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/... now show `Version: v3` for rebuilt endpoints; the `/docs/2021-07-28/...` pages still document `2021-07-28` and accept Private Integration Tokens (PIT) for every endpoint below ("Sub-Account OAuth access token or Private Integration Token").

## 1. Contacts listing vs search

**`GET /contacts/` (deprecated)** — https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/2021-07-28/ghl/contacts/get-contacts.md
- Doc says: "This API endpoint is deprecated. Please use the Search Contacts(contacts/search) endpoint instead."
- Query: `locationId` (required), `startAfterId` (string), `startAfter` (number, epoch ms of `dateAdded`), `query` (string), `limit` (default 20, max 100: "will allow maximum up to 100 and default will be 20").
- Response: `{ "contacts": [...], "count": <number> }` — `count` = "Total number of contacts matching the query". The 2021-07-28 spec defines **no `meta` object** (no `total`/`nextPageUrl`/`currentPage`) for contacts; `meta` exists only on the opportunities GET search (below). Cursor = take the last contact's `dateAdded` (as epoch ms) and `id` and pass them as `startAfter`/`startAfterId`. Ordering is by dateAdded only, so no incremental-by-`dateUpdated` sync. Use for nothing new.

**`POST /contacts/search` (use this)** — spec stub: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/2021-07-28/ghl/contacts/search-contacts-advanced.md (body schema `SearchBodyV2DTO` is published as an empty object `{}`; the real contract is in the linked HighLevel doc https://doc.clickup.com/8631005/d/h/87cpx-158396/6e629989abe7fad "Contacts Search API"). Scope `contacts.readonly`.

Request body (from the Contacts Search API doc):
```json
{
  "locationId": "5DP41231LkQsiKESj6rh",      // required
  "page": 1,                                 // optional; "When using searchAfter parameter, page should not be provided"
  "pageLimit": 20,                           // required; max 500 per request
  "searchAfter": ["bs5qhs78vqhs", "2FP41231LkQsiKESj6eg"],  // optional cursor; "Required for retrieving results beyond 10,000 records"
  "filters": [ { "field": "dnd", "operator": "eq", "value": true },
               { "group": "OR", "filters": [ { "field": "firstNameLowerCase", "operator": "eq", "value": "alex" } ] } ],
  "sort": [ { "field": "dateUpdated", "direction": "asc" } ],   // max 2 sort entries; direction asc|desc
  "query": "tom"                             // optional free text, max 75 chars, searches "searchable" custom-field settings
}
```
- Pagination limits: standard `page`+`pageLimit` can reach at most 10,000 records total, 500 per request ("page=20 and pageLimit=500 will provide you the last set"). Beyond 10,000 you must use `searchAfter`+`pageLimit` and omit `page`. `searchAfter` "is returned in the response of each document and defines where to start the next page from" — i.e. each contact in `contacts[]` carries a `searchAfter` array; pass the last contact's array verbatim. The doc's response example omits it, and the element shape (`[10, "ABC"]` in one example, two strings in another) is **unconfirmed**; treat as opaque `[]interface{}` and never construct it yourself. Note "updates may take a few seconds to appear in the search results" (eventually consistent index).
- Filters: top-level `filters[]` entries are ANDed by default; nested `{ "group": "AND"|"OR", "filters": [...] }` for grouping. Operators: `eq`, `not_eq` (Number/String/Boolean), `contains`, `not_contains` (String, no special characters, 75-char limit), `exists`, `not_exists` (no `value`), `range` (value type not stated for contacts; the sibling Opportunities Search doc defines range as "Object with gte, lte, gt, lt", e.g. `{"gte": 1000, "lte": 5000}` — assume the same object with ISO-8601 strings for dates; **unconfirmed** for date fields).
- Filterable fields relevant to import: `id` (eq/not_eq), `dateAdded` (range/exists/not_exists), `dateUpdated` (range/exists/not_exists), `tags` (eq/not_eq/contains/not_contains/exists/not_exists), `source` (same six), `assignedTo`, `dnd`, `email` (eq/not_eq/exists/not_exists; contains "not yet supported"), `phone`, `country`, `type`, `lastActivity` (range), `followers`, `firstNameLowerCase`, `lastNameLowerCase`, `contactName`, `businessName`, `companyName`, `city`, `state`, `postalCode`, `timezone`, `website`, `dateOfBirth`, `validEmail`, `isValidWhatsapp`, `activeWorkflows`, `finishedWorkflows`, `lastAppointment`, `lastEmailClickedDate`, `lastEmailOpenedDate`. Opportunity sub-filters use `field: "opportunities"` nested with sub fields `pipelineId`, `pipelineStageId`, `status`. Custom fields: `customFields.{{custom_field_id}}` — TEXT/LARGE_TEXT/SINGLE_OPTIONS/RADIO/PHONE: eq/not_eq/contains/not_contains/exists/not_exists; CHECKBOX/MULTIPLE_OPTIONS: eq/not_eq/exists/not_exists; NUMERICAL/MONETORY: range/eq/not_eq/exists/not_exists; DATE: range/exists/not_exists; TEXTBOX_LIST: `customFields.{{id}}.{{option_id}}`.
- Sortable fields: `firstNameLowerCase`, `lastNameLowerCase`, `businessName`, `dateAdded`, `dateUpdated`, `email`, `dnd`, `source`, `lastActivity`.
- Response: `{ "contacts": [ ... ], "total": 120 }` (no `meta`, no `nextPageUrl`).

Recommended sync: full load = `sort:[{dateAdded asc}]`, `pageLimit` 500 (or 100 to stay within burst limits), `searchAfter` cursor until `contacts` is empty or cumulative count reaches `total`. Incremental = `filters:[{field:"dateUpdated",operator:"range",value:{"gte":"<last watermark ISO>"}}]`, `sort:[{dateUpdated asc},{...}]` with `searchAfter`; keep a small overlap because the index lags writes. Deletes are not visible via search; need `ContactDelete` webhook or periodic id reconciliation.

## 2. Contact object

From `GET /contacts/{contactId}` (https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/2021-07-28/ghl/contacts/get-contact.md) and the search response example:
`id`, `locationId`, `firstName`, `lastName`, `name`, `email`, `phone`, `source`, `dateAdded` (ISO 8601), `dateUpdated` (ISO 8601), `tags: string[]`, `customFields: [{ "id": string, "value": ... }]`, `dnd: bool`, `dndSettings: { Call|Email|SMS|WhatsApp|GMB|FB: { status: "active"|"inactive"|"permanent", message?, code? } }`, `country`, `type` (e.g. `"lead"`), `assignedTo` (user id), `lastActivity`, `businessId`, `dateOfBirth` (YYYY-MM-DD), `timezone`, `companyName`, `address1`, `city`, `state`, `postalCode`, `website`, `additionalEmails`, `additionalPhones`, `followers: string[]`, `attributionSource`, `lastAttributionSource`.
- `customFields[].value`: the get-contact schema types it as string only, but the search doc example shows `"value": ["option - 1", "option -2"]` for multi-select, and webhook payloads describe `value` as "string, number, array, or object". Decode as `json.RawMessage`/`interface{}`.
- Search results return `firstNameLowerCase`/`lastNameLowerCase` instead of `firstName`/`lastName` ("first name without lowercase is not yet available") — and `name` is absent in the search example. If you need cased names, fetch `GET /contacts/{id}` or accept lowercase.
- **No `attributions[]` array exists.** Attribution is two objects: `attributionSource` (first touch) and `lastAttributionSource` (last touch). Field names (search example): `utmSource`, `utmMedium`, `utmContent`, `utmKeyword`, `utmTerm`, `utmMatchtype`, `sessionSource`, `medium`, `mediumId`, `campaign`, `campaignId`, `gclid`, `fbclid`, `gbraid`, `wbraid`, `adId`, `adGroupId`, `adName`, `adSource`, `referrer`, `fbc`, `fbp`, `userAgent`, `ip`, `gaClientId`, `url`. The get-contact schema lists the subset `url` (required), `campaign`, `utmSource`, `utmMedium`, `utmContent`, `referrer`, `campaignId`, `fbclid`, `gclid`, `msclikid`, `dclid`, `fbc`, `fbp`, `fbEventId`, `userAgent`, `ip`, `medium`, `mediumId`. No `utmCampaign` (use `campaign`), no `isFirst` (first vs last is the object name). Model both objects with all keys optional.

## 3. Single get / update / tags

- `GET /contacts/{contactId}` → `{ "contact": {...} }`; scope `contacts.readonly`.
- `PUT /contacts/{contactId}` (https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/2021-07-28/ghl/contacts/update-contact.md); scope `contacts.write`. Body `customFields: [{ "id": "<fieldId>" | "key": "<fieldKey>", "field_value": <value> }]` — "Pass either id or key of custom field"; `field_value` is string for TEXT/LARGE_TEXT/SINGLE_OPTIONS/RADIO, number for NUMERICAL/MONETORY, string[] for CHECKBOX/MULTIPLE_OPTIONS, object for FILE. (The 2021-07-28 page marks `field_value` as deprecated in favour of `fieldValue`; the v3 page uses `fieldValue`. Send `field_value` on 2021-07-28; **unconfirmed** whether both are accepted there.) Only the custom fields you send are touched, so writing `adx_*` fields does not clear others. `tags` in PUT "will overwrite all current tags associated with the contact" — never send it from ADX. Response `{ "succeeded": bool, "contact": {...} }` (`succeded` legacy spelling deprecated).
- Tags: `POST /contacts/{contactId}/tags` body `{ "tags": ["a","b"] }` → 201 `{ "tags": [<all current tags>] }`; `DELETE /contacts/{contactId}/tags` same body → 200 `{ "tags": [...] }`. Both `contacts.write`. (https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/2021-07-28/ghl/contacts/remove-tags.md)

## 4. Custom fields

`GET /locations/{locationId}/customFields?model=contact|opportunity|all` (https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/2021-07-28/ghl/locations/get-custom-fields.md); scope `locations/customFields.readonly`. Response:
```json
{ "customFields": [ { "id": "3sv6UEo51C9Bmpo1cKTq", "name": "pincode", "fieldKey": "contact.pincode",
  "placeholder": "Pin code", "dataType": "TEXT", "position": 0, "picklistOptions": ["first option"],
  "picklistImageOptions": [], "isAllowedCustomOption": false, "isMultiFileAllowed": true, "maxFileLimit": 4,
  "locationId": "...", "model": "contact" } ] }
```
`dataType` enum: TEXT, LARGE_TEXT, NUMERICAL, PHONE, MONETORY (sic), CHECKBOX, SINGLE_OPTIONS, MULTIPLE_OPTIONS, FLOAT, TIME, DATE, TEXTBOX_LIST, FILE_UPLOAD, SIGNATURE, RADIO, URL, DATE_TIME, USER, RICH_TEXT. `fieldKey` is `contact.<snake_name>` / `opportunity.<name>`. No `parentId`/`standard` in the spec. Not paginated.

`POST /locations/{locationId}/customFields` (https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/2021-07-28/ghl/locations/create-custom-field.md); scope `locations/customFields.write`. Body: `name` (required), `dataType` (required), `placeholder`, `position` (default 0), `model` ("contact"|"opportunity"), `acceptedFormat[]`, `isMultipleFile`, `maxNumberOfFiles`, `textBoxListOptions[{label,prefillValue}]`, plus `urlValidation`/`dateTimeValidation`/`userFieldConfig`/`optionDisplayType`. **Unconfirmed**: how to supply picklist options on create (the schema lists no `options`/`picklistOptions` input; ADX can use TEXT/NUMERICAL fields and avoid it). Response 201 `{ "customField": {...same shape as above...} }`.

## 5. Opportunities

`GET /opportunities/search` (https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/2021-07-28/ghl/opportunities/search-opportunity.md); scope `opportunities.readonly`. Query (snake_case): `location_id` (required), `q` (max 75), `pipeline_id`, `pipeline_stage_id`, `contact_id`, `status` (`open|won|lost|abandoned|all`), `assigned_to`, `campaignId`, `id`, `order` (`added_asc|added_desc|name_asc|name_desc`), `date` and `endDate` (mm-dd-yyyy), `startAfter` (epoch ms), `startAfterId`, `country`, `page` (default 1), `limit` (default 20, **max 100**), `getTasks`, `getNotes`, `getCalendarEvents`.
Response: `{ "opportunities": [...], "meta": { "total", "nextPageUrl", "startAfterId", "startAfter" (number), "currentPage", "nextPage", "prevPage" }, "aggregations": {} }`. Opportunity fields: `id`, `name`, `monetaryValue` (number), `pipelineId`, `pipelineStageId`, `assignedTo`, `status`, `source`, `lastStatusChangeAt`, `lastStageChangeAt`, `lastActionDate`, `createdAt`, `updatedAt` (ISO 8601), `indexVersion`, `contactId`, `locationId`, `contact: { id, name, companyName, email, phone, tags[] }`, `notes[]`, `tasks[]`, `calendarEvents[]`, `customFields: [{ "id", "fieldValue" }]`, `followers[]`, `lostReasonId`, `externalObjectId`, forecast fields. No date-updated filter on the GET variant; `meta.nextPageUrl` carries the cursor.

Better for large/incremental sync: `POST /opportunities/search` (https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/opportunities/search-opportunities-advanced.md, detail doc https://doc.clickup.com/8631005/d/h/87cpx-424216/7bf11bc9b94f80f; the stub shows `Version: v3` — **unconfirmed** whether it accepts `2021-07-28`). Body: `locationId`, `page` (min 0), `limit` (min 1, **max 500**), `searchAfter[]`, `query`, `filters[]`, `sort[]`, `additionalDetails{notes,tasks,calendarEvents}`. Same operator set; `range` = `{ "gte", "lte", "gt", "lt" }`. Fields are snake_case here: `date_added`, `date_updated`, `last_status_change_date`, `last_stage_change_date` (range), `status`, `pipeline_id`, `pipeline_stage_id`, `contact_id`, `assigned_to`, `source`, `monetary_value`, `custom_fields.{{id}}`. Sort fields: `date_added`, `date_updated`, `name`, `monetary_value`, `last_status_change_date`, `last_stage_change_date`. Response `{ "opportunities": [...], "total": 120, "aggregations": {} }` — note `custom_fields` (snake) `[{ "id", "fieldValue": string|string[] }]` and `relations[]` in this variant; same 10,000-record cap without `searchAfter`.

`GET /opportunities/pipelines?locationId=` (https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/2021-07-28/ghl/opportunities/get-pipelines.md); scope `opportunities.readonly`. Response `{ "pipelines": [ { "id", "name", "stages": [...], "showInFunnel", "showInPieChart", "locationId", "useOpportunityProbability", "colorRenderMode": "dot|bg-tint|none", "position" (string, fractional index) } ] }`. The spec types `stages` as a bare array with no item schema; `{id, name, position}` per stage is the widely observed shape but **unconfirmed** in docs — decode leniently and log unknown keys. No `dateAdded`/`dateUpdated` on pipelines.

## 6. Webhooks

- Webhooks are configured only on a Marketplace OAuth app (Advanced Settings → Webhooks: turn on events, paste URL). The authorization guide says pick a Private Integration Token "If you don't need webhooks or custom design or pages" and OAuth when "an integration that requires features like webhooks" (https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/2021-07-28/Authorization/authorization_doc.md). Nothing in the PIT doc (https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/Authorization/PrivateIntegrationsToken.md) mentions webhooks. Conclusion: **PITs cannot receive webhooks**; ADX needs a (private, unlisted) Marketplace app with OAuth to get them, or must poll. (Workflow "Webhook" actions inside the sub-account are a separate, UI-configured feature not covered here.)
- Event names (https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/category/webhook): `ContactCreate`, `ContactUpdate`, `ContactDelete`, `ContactDndUpdate`, `ContactTagUpdate`, `OpportunityCreate`, `OpportunityUpdate`, `OpportunityDelete`, `OpportunityAssignedToUpdate`, `OpportunityMonetaryValueUpdate`, `OpportunityStageUpdate`, `OpportunityStatusUpdate`, plus Note*, Task*, Appointment*, Invoice*, App*, Location*, User* etc. Scope mapping: `contacts.readonly` grants ContactCreate/ContactDelete/ContactDndUpdate/ContactTagUpdate (ContactUpdate not listed under it in the scopes table — **unconfirmed** which scope carries it); `opportunities.readonly` grants OpportunityCreate/Delete/StageUpdate/StatusUpdate/MonetaryValueUpdate.
- Contact payload (ContactCreate/Update/TagUpdate share it): `{ "type": "ContactCreate", "locationId", "id", "address1", "city", "state", "postalCode", "country", "companyName", "source", "name", "firstName", "lastName", "dateAdded", "dateUpdated", "dateOfBirth", "dnd", "email", "additionalEmails":[{"email"}], "phone", "phoneLabel", "additionalPhones":[{"phone","phoneLabel"}], "tags":[], "website", "assignedTo", "customFields":[{"id","value"}] }`. No attribution objects in webhook payloads. Opportunity payload: `{ "type": "OpportunityStageUpdate", "locationId", "id", "assignedTo", "contactId", "monetaryValue", "name", "pipelineId", "pipelineStageId", "source", "status", "dateAdded" }`. The guide's test payload also shows `timestamp` (ISO) and `webhookId` (use for dedupe); they are not in the per-event schemas.
- Signature (https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/webhook/WebhookIntegrationGuide.md): header `X-GHL-Signature` = base64 Ed25519 signature over the raw body, public key `-----BEGIN PUBLIC KEY-----\nMCowBQYDK2VwAyEAi2HR1srL4o18O8BRa7gVJY7G7bupbN3H9AwJrHCDiOg=\n-----END PUBLIC KEY-----`. Legacy `X-WH-Signature` = RSA-SHA256 with a longer RSA key printed in the guide; the guide says it is deprecated on September 1, 2026 (another version says July 1, 2026). Verify Ed25519 when present, else RSA, else reject. Retries: any non-2xx or timeout → exponential backoff with jitter, up to 12 retries, stop on first 2xx.

## 7. Rate limits

https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/other/rate-limits.md — "Burst: 100 requests per 10 seconds", "Daily: 200,000 requests per day", scoped per Marketplace app (client) per resource (one Location or one Company); installing on more sub-accounts "does not divide your allowance". The page is written for OAuth apps; it does not mention PITs (**unconfirmed** that identical numbers apply to a PIT, but PITs are described as "static/fixed OAuth2 Access Tokens", so assume the same). Headers on every response: `X-RateLimit-Limit-Daily`, `X-RateLimit-Daily-Remaining`, `X-RateLimit-Interval-Milliseconds`, `X-RateLimit-Max`, `X-RateLimit-Remaining`; the docs say to treat them as authoritative. 429 body and `Retry-After` are **not documented**; implement: on 429 sleep until `X-RateLimit-Interval-Milliseconds` elapses (or backoff with jitter), and stop the run when `X-RateLimit-Daily-Remaining` nears zero. Budget: a 50k-contact full import at 500/page is ~100 search calls, trivial; per-contact `GET /contacts/{id}` is what burns quota.

## 8. Errors

Per-endpoint DTOs (e.g. https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/2021-07-28/ghl/contacts/get-contact.md): 400 `{ "statusCode": 400, "message": "Bad Request" }`; 401 `{ "statusCode": 401, "message": "Invalid token: access token is invalid", "error": "Unauthorized" }`; 422 `{ "statusCode": 422, "message": ["Unprocessable Entity"], "error": "Unprocessable Entity" }` — `message` is a string on 400/401 and an array of strings on 422, so decode as `json.RawMessage`. 403 is not in the specs; a token lacking the scope or location access returns 401/403 with the same `{statusCode,message,error}` shape (**unconfirmed** code and text). Community reports show `{"statusCode":401,"message":"Invalid JWT"}` for bad/missing tokens or a missing `Version` header. 404 `{statusCode:404,...}` for unknown contact id (**unconfirmed**).

## 9. Scopes (https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/Authorization/Scopes.md, all Sub-Account)

- `contacts.readonly`: `GET /contacts/`, `GET /contacts/:contactId`, `POST /contacts/search`, contact tasks/notes/appointments reads.
- `contacts.write`: `POST /contacts/`, `PUT /contacts/:contactId`, `DELETE /contacts/:contactId`, `POST /contacts/:contactId/tags`, `DELETE /contacts/:contactId/tags`, tasks/notes/campaign/workflow writes. **No dedicated scope for contact tag add/remove** — it is under `contacts.write`.
- `locations/tags.readonly` / `locations/tags.write`: only the location-level tag catalogue `GET/POST/PUT/DELETE /locations/:locationId/tags[/:tagId]` (useful to list all tags defined in the sub-account; not needed to read a contact's tags).
- `locations/customFields.readonly`: `GET /locations/:locationId/customFields`, `GET /locations/:locationId/customFields/:id`; `locations/customFields.write`: `POST/PUT/DELETE /locations/:locationId/customFields[/:id]`.
- `opportunities.readonly`: `GET /opportunities/search`, `GET /opportunities/:id`, `GET /opportunities/pipelines` (and POST search); `opportunities.write` for mutations.
- `locations.readonly`: `GET /locations/:locationId`, `GET /locations/search`, `GET /locations/timeZones` — handy for a connection health check (location name, timezone).
Minimum PIT scope set for ADX import + own-field writes: `contacts.readonly`, `contacts.write`, `locations/customFields.readonly`, `locations/customFields.write`, `opportunities.readonly`, `locations.readonly` (optional `locations/tags.readonly`).
